notes.title: Update notes for Hotfix v0.34.3
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.34.3 change log:[/h1]

Just a small fix to address a soft lock problem.

[b]- Bug fixes / Miscellaneous:[/b]

Fixed an issue with the Morning event on Day 09 Month 03 not triggering properly, resulting in a soft lock.


[h3]Looking for your old save files?[/h3]
There was a problem with the old save file location, but if you're looking for your old saves you can still find them.

Your old save data will be stored at:
C:\Users\User\AppData\LocalLow\DefaultCompany\Lord Goblin

You want to copy/past the files in there into:
C:\Users\User\AppData\LocalLow\BigBrassBand\Lord Goblin

That said, old saves often introduce bugs. Regardless, we shouldn't have to do this again in the future.

notes.title: The Heroes & Villeins Update - v0.34.2
notes.content:
No, the event name is not a misspelling- it's villein as in serf. It's a feudalism pun. We're bringing you more of what you want- more animations, more sex scenes, more voice acting, and new court events! We hope you guys enjoy what we've been cooking up!

Additionally, we are working on adding in support for more aspect ratios/resolution, do not hesitate to share your feedback on this matter.

Overview-
[list]
[*] A new animated sex scene in the introduction,
[*] A new animated Cliona blowjob ritual,
[*] A new event chain that can lead to a Delia spanking reward scene,
[*] Revisions to the "Vital Villeins" and "Aspiring Artisans" events, so that they will now occur every week once you've upgraded the crops or bridge respectively, and will allow you to reliably buy more population,
[*] Many new voiced lines throughout the game,
[*] Other new holding court events,
[*] UI improvements,
[*] Many bug fixes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45055310/146d569c6ad79685644133f7f0f809dda55352fc.gif[/img]

See the full changelog below for more info

[b]Version 0.34.2 changelog:[/b]

[b]- Gameplay & UI related changes:[/b]

[b]- 'Holding Court' screen:[/b]
'Delia the Disgrace (part 2)' Random event added as part of an event chain (2 of 2)
'Delia the Disgrace spanking scene' added as possible choice of 'Delia the Disgrace (part 2)'
Reworked the 'Aspiring artisans' into a weekly event (Friday), unlocked after upgrading the 'Bridge' in the Village
Reworked the 'Vital villeins' into a weekly event (Thursday), unlocked after upgrading the 'Crops' in the Village

[b]- 'Manor' screen[/b]
Updated the intro sex scene with some animation
Added a new scene involving Az'ea and Cliona arguing about civilisation while in town (from 6th day, 4th month), as a prerequisite and lead up to the existing similar scene of them arguing about Lord Goblin needing a harem
Added some voicelines for current content

[b]- 'Perform Ritual' screen[/b]
Updated Cliona's blowjob ritual sprites with a proper arm free variant

[b]- 'Holding Court' screen[/b]
'Why, fallow there!' Random event added
'Sir Tainly, Sir' Random one time event added as part of an event chain (1 of 2)
'Sir Tainly Important' Random one time event added as possible follow-up to 'Sir Tainly, Sir' (2 of 2)
'Sir Tainly Angry' Random one time event added as possible follow-up to 'Sir Tainly, Sir' (2 of 2)

[b]- Bug fixes / Miscellaneous:[/b]

Fixed the Barracks 'Upgrade' button not behaving properly
Fixed the 'Perform Ritual' button not bringing in the 'Portal Ritual' UI properly
Fixed the ambiance sound persisting when going back to the Main Menu
Fixed the 'Clean up a room' job action not resetting properly
Fixed the 'A cock laid an egg' event first choice being greyed out if legitimacy was at or below 4
Fixed the 'Word On The Street 02' event first choice leading to the same outcome as the second
Fixed the condition check for Cliona's ('Ritual Blowjob') to 25 obedience
Fixed Beth's 'Ritual Titjob (Interested)' not properly displaying the choices and causing a soft lock
Fixed the 'Aspiring artisans' condition check
Fixed the 'Vital villeins' condition check
